subcapability: Criterion 3 - legacy file runs reproduce reference results through adapters

criterion.normative_text: legacy file runs still reproduce reference results through adapters;

examples: toswap%rad [kJ m-2 d-1] -> rad = toswap%rad * 1000 [J m-2 d-1]
toswap%rain [mm d-1] -> graidt = nraidt = toswap%rain * 0.1 [cm d-1]
toswap%lai -> lai, toswap%ch [cm] -> ch, toswap%zroot [cm] -> rd
when ipet == 1: toswap%ptrans [mm d-1] -> ptra_dry = ptra = 0.1 * ptrans [cm d-1]
when ipet == 1: toswap%pevap [mm d-1] -> peva = empreva = epond = 0.1 * pevap [cm d-1], followed by reduceva(rain * 0.1)
recovered_legacy_external_contract.scope_limitation: These transformations belong to the external DLL-style exchange path and do not establish equivalence with the normal file-driven Hupsel path.

observed_chain: crop rotation and optional WOFOST assimilation
legacy_file_driven_composition.finding: The normal legacy file route composes raw meteo/crop/configuration inputs through multiple application processes before the soil-water computational boundary. A direct raw-file-field to soil-water-forcing mapping is therefore not semantically equivalent.

current_typed_target.canonical_forcing_base: canonical_forcing_t is an abstract empty base type; forcing semantics are supplied by concrete model/process contracts.
current_typed_target.finding: The admitted physical backend consumes process-ready interval forcing. It does not own Hupsel meteo/crop/ET/file composition.

missing_authoritative_mappings: file-driven precipitation/meteo/interception state -> admitted interval top_flux
file-driven crop state and potential transpiration -> nodewise root_extraction_sink(:)
legacy bottom-boundary configuration and time-dependent evaluation -> bottom_head/bottom_flux
legacy drainage configuration and dynamic response -> typed drainage forcing/control surface
legacy irrigation/SSDI application composition -> typed source terms where applicable
activation and composition rules for optional process forcing in a real Hupsel run
field_level_break.why_external_exchange_is_not_a_substitut: The external exchange path imposes its own restricted switches and injects already selected daily weather/crop/PET data. The Hupsel reference is a normal file-driven application that executes ReadSwap, Meteo, crop/interception/root-extraction/bottom/drainage composition internally. Treating the DLL field transformations as the Hupsel file adapter would change the application semantics being qualified.

repository_source_coverage.committed_b1_10_port: A preserved subset containing headcalc.f90, soilwater.f90, swap.f90, swap_main.f90 and swap_part01..04.inc.
repository_source_coverage.full_legacy_source_authority: Qualified by F-VQ99 from the official user-supplied SWAP 4.3.1 distribution as external immutable evidence, but not committed as a complete source tree in this repository.
repository_source_coverage.consequence: The complete file-parser/meteo/crop application composition cannot be recovered field-for-field from the committed B1.10 port subset alone.

interpretation: The blocker is now localized below generic provenance. Some legacy input units and transformations are exact, but the scientifically material transformation from a real legacy file-driven Hupsel application to the current process-ready typed interval forcing is not an admitted mapping. Implementing direct rain/ET/crop-to-backend assignments would invent or bypass legacy application composition and cannot satisfy criterion 3.
mutations: Added this field-level reconciliation/blocker checkpoint only.
next_permitted_action: Do not implement an M1-C3 production adapter on the present authority. If criterion 3 must be completed, first open or explicitly admit a bounded application-composition contract that uses the qualified full legacy source/fixture as the input-side authority and the already-admitted typed process/backend seams as the target. Recover and qualify the composition process-by-process before any file adapter is admitted. The restricted external DLL exchange mapping must not be treated as equivalent to the Hupsel file-driven path. Independently closable M1 criteria, especially criterion 4, may continue on their existing branches.
